summary: The full PPO, trajectory collection and pair-audit pipeline completed. The final preregistered deterministic policy missed SC-1 at 29.6875% success, while both stochastic collection splits exceeded their 30% target and all dataset audits passed. Post-hoc larger stochastic evaluation showed that the original metric understated performance but still left a substantial gap to the public easy-200 reference curve.

observations.name: cpu_test_status
observations.observed: Core PPO, Gym3 alignment, checkpoint, collection-boundary and dataset-audit tests pass on CPU; the full branch suite has 97 passing tests.

observations.name: runtime_preflight
observations.observed: Python 3.10.12, Procgen 0.10.7 and JAX 0.4.35 passed the fixed CPU action/model smoke. The same environment saw cuda:0 and produced actor logits shape [1,15] and values shape [1].

observations.name: active_run
observations.observed: Attempt 8303d788-8966-4850-86a2-d87bc9a47366 entered RUNNING under PID 81218 with max_steps=1536 and W&B offline; it reached 8 completed updates / 131,072 transitions while the PID remained alive.

observations.name: audited_stochastic_collection
observations.observed: The final frozen checkpoint produced 4,096 train records and 512 eval records of 64 frames. Train/eval completed-episode success was 55.6904%/65.7534%; both split audits and the pair audit were valid.

observations.name: posthoc_full_distribution_evaluation
observations.observed: On 512 stochastic full-distribution episodes, the 22,020,096-step checkpoint reached mean return 5.390625 and the final checkpoint reached 4.9609375. The final checkpoint remained materially below the public easy-200 curve.

deviations.reason: JAX 0.4.35 imports nvidia.cuda_nvcc.__file__, while the unconstrained CUDA 12.9 nvcc wheel exposes a namespace package with __file__=None.
deviations.change: Pinned nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12 to 12.4.131 and added a regression test before rerunning the preflight.

deviations.reason: The shared logger called jax.distributed.is_initialized(), which is absent in the frozen JAX 0.4.35 API.
deviations.change: Used the already-established optional-API pattern from dreamer.parallel, added a regression test, and relaunched from a clean detached worktree.

deviations.reason: The final 64-episode deterministic result was unexpectedly low.
deviations.change: Evaluated peak and final checkpoints with both stochastic sampling and larger samples, including 512 episodes over num_levels=0. No training result or checkpoint was changed.

failures.message: JAX 0.4.35 received nvidia.cuda_nvcc.__file__=None from the unbounded CUDA 12.9 namespace package.
jax.distributed has no attribute is_initialized under JAX 0.4.35.

observed: The runtime preflight passed on CPU and on the A10 with the exact 15-action actor interface.
Training completed exactly 25,165,824 environment transitions and froze checkpoint SHA256 88f3cff15cd46518c14b9add81a913d8a9afcfed1143b234ecabdf8b0b29cbb6.
The final preregistered deterministic success rate was 29.6875%, below the 50% threshold, although the 22,020,096-step milestone reached 51.5625%.
Both collected datasets exceeded 30% completed-episode success and passed count, action, terminal, checkpoint and split-pair audits.
A 512-episode stochastic full-distribution diagnostic measured final mean return 4.9609375.
interpretation: The deterministic 64-episode metric understated stochastic policy quality, but evaluation protocol alone does not explain the gap to the public easy-200 reference.

The late drop from the best checkpoint to the final checkpoint and several public-recipe mismatches justify a from-scratch official-recipe parity control before using this collector for a new dynamics run.
not_established: Whether the collected trajectories improve action-conditioned dynamics.
Which individual recipe mismatch causes the remaining return gap.
decision: Retain the checkpoint and audited data as an internal result but do not authorize dynamics from it yet.
Run CR-PPO-0002 from scratch with the public easy-200 recipe alignment.
Do not start dynamics or any imitation-policy stage.
